text: Discuss articles: Every article card now has a comments section. Share a take, a critique, or how a study changes your practice, and see what colleagues think.

Weekly email: That's this email! Every Saturday you'll get 3 suggested articles to read. You can turn it off anytime with the link at the bottom, or under "Email notification settings" at the top of the site.
All Studies is complete: It now lists every article that scored above 3, in every specialty, instead of only the top 100. Tap "Show more" at the bottom to keep going.
Login fix: Fixed a problem where, after an app update, you could find yourself signed in to a colleague's account. You may be asked to sign in again once.
Tidier specialty filter: On All Studies, the specialty list now only shows specialties that actually have articles, so you won't land on an empty page.
